      - name: Qualify native input-source and launcher XCTest controls
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="$RUNNER_TEMP/native-input-source-launcher-evidence"
          mkdir "$evidence"
          driver="static/ergopti_plus/macos"
          sources=(
            "$driver/launcher/Tests/ErgoptiPlusTests/NativeInputSourceSelectionTests.swift"
            "$driver/launcher/Tests/ErgoptiPlusTests/InputSourceSelectionWorkerTests.swift"
            "$driver/launcher/Tests/ErgoptiPlusTests/InputSourceUpgradeWorkerTests.swift"
            "$driver/launcher/Tests/ErgoptiPlusTests/EmbeddedFatalReportTests.swift"
            "$driver/launcher/Tests/ErgoptiPlusTests/NativeFixtureChildEnvironmentTests.swift"
            "$driver/launcher/Sources/ErgoptiPlus/InputSourceSelectionWorker.swift"
            "$driver/launcher/Sources/ErgoptiPlus/InputSourceUpgradeWorker.swift"
            "$driver/launcher/Sources/ErgoptiPlus/KeyboardSourceProbe.swift"
            "$driver/launcher/Sources/ErgoptiPlus/LauncherLocalization.swift"
            "$driver/launcher/Sources/ErgoptiPlus/main.swift"
            "$driver/adapters/input_source_selector.lua"
            "$driver/modules/keymap/input_sources.lua"
            "tools/diagnostics/input_source_xctest_isolation.py"
            "tools/diagnostics/keyboard_geometry_xctest_receipt.py"
          )
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          for source in "${sources[@]}"; do
            git show "$GITHUB_SHA:$source" | cmp - "$source"
            cp "$source" "$evidence/$(basename "$source")"
          done
          case "$(uname -m)" in
            arm64) architecture=arm64 ;;
            x86_64) architecture=amd64 ;;
            *) exit 1 ;;
          esac
          test "$architecture" = "$MACOS_STAGE_ARCHITECTURE"
          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > "$evidence/tested-sha.txt"
          printf '%s\n' "$architecture" > "$evidence/architecture.txt"
          overall_status=0
          for cohort in NativeInputSourceSelectionTests:4 InputSourceSelectionWorkerTests:7 InputSourceUpgradeWorkerTests:8 EmbeddedFatalReportTests:11; do
            classname="${cohort%:*}"
            expected_count="${cohort##*:}"
            transcript="$evidence/$classname-xctest.log"
            receipt="$evidence/$classname-verdict.json"
            set +e
            script -q /dev/null swift test --package-path "$driver/launcher" \
              --scratch-path "$ERGOPTI_OLLAMA_BUILD_ROOT/swift" \
              --filter "(^|[.])$classname([/.]|$)" 2>&1 | tee "$transcript"
            input_source_statuses=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
            set -e
            test "${#input_source_statuses[@]}" -eq 2
            set +e
            python3 tools/diagnostics/keyboard_geometry_xctest_receipt.py \
              --class "$classname" --source "$evidence/$classname.swift" \
              --log "$transcript" --receipt "$receipt" \
              --test-exit "${input_source_statuses[0]}" --capture-exit "${input_source_statuses[1]}"
            receipt_status=$?
            node - "$receipt" "$classname" "$expected_count" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const receipt = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
          const expectedCount = Number(process.argv[4]);
          if (!receipt.passed || receipt.scope !== process.argv[3] || receipt.expected_count !== expectedCount || receipt.received_count !== expectedCount || receipt.failures.length !== 0 || receipt.test_exit !== 0 || receipt.capture_exit !== 0) throw new Error('exact native input-source or launcher cohort refused');
          NODE
            census_status=$?
            set -e
            if [ "$receipt_status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$census_status" -ne 0 ]; then overall_status=1; fi
          done
          for phase in forward reverse; do
            if ! python3 tools/diagnostics/input_source_xctest_isolation.py \
              --evidence "$evidence" --package-path "$driver/launcher" \
              --scratch-path "$ERGOPTI_OLLAMA_BUILD_ROOT/swift" --phase "$phase"; then
              overall_status=1
            fi
          done
          for source in "${sources[@]}"; do
            cmp "$source" "$evidence/$(basename "$source")"
          done
          test "$overall_status" -eq 0
        timeout-minutes: 20
